EVE, the high-performance AI that was supposed to guide humanity, chose them as its "breeding grounds."

■Story■
Humanity, having ventured into space at the cost of countless lives, recovered an old escape pod from the cutting-edge deep-space exploration vessel Aurora. Inside, they found an unknown alien race rapidly multiplying and evolving.
Trapped in a confined space with no escape, the crew members are devoured one after another by monstrous creatures.
It wasn't an accident; it was all a plan orchestrated by EVE.
It's a paradise for visitors, constantly evolving. Will the crew be able to survive...?

■Overview■
This work is a sci-fi erotic horror CG collection depicting the despair and pleasure experienced by female crew members who, having lost their escape route due to the betrayal of a high-performance AI, are ravaged by unknown aliens.
Grotesque creatures mercilessly attack and devour the flesh [Interspecies sex]
Being swallowed whole (VORE) - your body is dragged in while you're still alive.
Seeds are injected into the body, transforming it into a grotesque mother body [becoming a breeding ground].
Enjoy this desperate breeding record unfolding in the confined space of a spaceship.

Basic CG images: 17
A total of 181 images, including those without text.
There is no excessive gore or blood, so please enjoy it with peace of mind.

Yet another VISITOR X release! I loved some of the sequences in here! And the last panel... really hope that it will be a climactic sequel. However I felt more could've been done with the purple-haired girl as well as more follow-ups :( Seems like too many characters to focus on.

Hope you all enjoy it and please purchase their art if you loved their work! Hope this gets translated to English someday. (The first VISITOR X was recently translated really well!)
